allocation_impact: Check before size-controlled allocation/retention and include raw framing, decoded values, copies and lower-layer work. Reserve end-to-end capacity; do not release while submitted work, completion or ambiguity remains.
boundary_tests: Exactly 32 bytes accepted only with canonical encoding; 31 and 33 rejected
Text and binary boundaries bind the same opaque operation; conflicting retry cannot mint a new identity
notes: Fixed configured cap, not required actual occupancy/size. Internal boundary adds no wire enum. Written boundary tests are future implementation obligations, not executed proof. Fixed profile per #342 addendum; meaningful smaller profiles unsupported. Source-age/authentication constraints remain independent. Persistent floors/denials/receipts are never evicted to meet resident limits; no automatic retry, background refresh or coalesced waiter fanout.
